column1: The app is fast and intuitive, but the latest update introduced a few annoying bugs.
Great customer support. They responded within minutes and solved my issue.
I love the clean interface and the new dashboard. It helps me track everything.
The price feels a bit high for the features offered, but overall it works fine.
Frequent crashes on startup. Reinstalling helped for a day, then it broke again.
Setup was easy and the onboarding tutorial was actually useful.
The search feature is inaccurate and often returns irrelevant results.
Amazing performance on my laptop, and battery usage is much better now.
Notifications are too aggressive. I wish I could customize them more.
The product quality is solid, but shipping was slow and packaging was damaged.
Refund process was simple. I appreciate the transparent policy.
Sometimes it freezes when I open large files, which hurts productivity.
The integration with Google Drive is seamless and saves me a lot of time.
I keep getting logged out randomly. Please fix the authentication issues.
Overall a good experience: stable, reliable, and easy to use every day.
